fact: The Polícia Nacional of São Tomé e Príncipe signed a collaboration protocol with the operator UNITEL STP on 6 February 2024 to develop technology solutions and digital services for its internal procedures, under axis three of its 2021-2024 strategic plan.
title: Polícia Nacional de São Tomé e Príncipe e UNITEL STP celebram protocolo de colaboração para avanço tecnológico
